    Step Inside Halloween House Philly: A Spooky, Family-Friendly Adventure Opens at Fashion District Philadelphia

    Philadelphia has a brand-new way to celebrate spooky season. Halloween House Philly, New Jersey’s most popular all-ages Halloween attraction, has officially expanded into Center City, bringing an immersive and family-friendly…

    Philadelphia Newsroom Staff
    Published Oct 13, 2026 11:41 AM EDT
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:51
    Instaread

    Philadelphia has a brand-new way to celebrate spooky season. Halloween House Philly, New Jersey's most popular all-ages Halloween attraction, has officially expanded into Center City, bringing an immersive and family-friendly Halloween experience to Fashion District Philadelphia.

    Located on the second floor of Fashion District Philadelphia near Primark, Halloween House Philly transforms the former Forever 21 space into a festive indoor Halloween destination designed for visitors of every age. Unlike traditional haunted houses, this attraction focuses on fun rather than fear. There are no live monsters, frightening actors, or unexpected jump scares. Instead, guests can explore imaginative environments, interactive activities, and themed experiences at their own pace.

    Have you seen this?

    The 2026 edition of Halloween House Philly is bigger than ever, featuring double the space and 10 fully themed rooms. Returning favorites include the Glow Room, Zombie Bunker, Spiderweb Spectacle, and Carnival of Horrors. Visitors can also enjoy all-new additions such as the Jeopardy Room, Karaoke/Dance Room, and a Backrooms-inspired experience that adds a unique twist to this year's attraction.

    RELATED: Stateside Live! Plans 'Midnight Manor' Halloween Party With Costume Contests on Oct. 31

    According to owner Peter Coyle, the goal is simple: create unforgettable Halloween memories for everyone. Every room brings the spirit of Halloween to life in a different way, offering surprises around every corner, hands-on activities, incredible photo opportunities, and interactive challenges. The adventure even ends with both a surprise trick and a surprise treat.

    Halloween House Philly is also introducing several themed event days throughout the season. Guests can participate in special celebrations including Netflix Night, Eagles Day, Halloween Movies Day, GTA Day, and The Nightmare Before Christmas-themed event on Halloween. Many of these specialty days include contests and prizes, giving visitors even more reasons to return throughout October.

    One of the biggest draws is the attraction's accessibility. Located inside Fashion District Philadelphia near the AMC Theatres entrance at 10th and Filbert Streets, the entire experience is indoors, making it a perfect rain-or-shine activity. Whether you're planning a family outing, date night, gathering with friends, birthday celebration, or seasonal adventure, Halloween House Philly offers a welcoming environment for all.

    Most groups spend about 40 to 45 minutes exploring the attraction, and visitors are welcome to revisit their favorite rooms before leaving. Tickets are available for children and teens, individual adults, family and friend packs, as well as VIP experiences.

    For anyone looking to celebrate Halloween without the scares, Halloween House Philly delivers a colorful, immersive, and memorable way to enjoy the season. With themed rooms, interactive experiences, special event days, and endless photo opportunities, this new Center City attraction is ready to become a must-visit Halloween destination in Philadelphia.
